notes.title: Thalamus Soundtrack
notes.content: Hey everyone, we are sad to announce that we have to take down the Thalamus Soundtrack due to copyright issues. We made the mistake of not correctly understanding copyright and ownership. We apologize to everyone involved and hope you can stick with us as we improve.

notes.title: Thalamus speed running announcement.
notes.content:
[h1]Thalamus speed running announcement.[/h1]

Hey everyone we would like to announce that we have made a speed running page for those of you who are interested in speed running the game. We have already set up a channel in our discord if you would like to talk to some fellow runners. As of writing this the time to beat is 12:12 by Klania911. We hope everyone has fun while we try to finish chapter 2 (and do a few runs of our own). HAPPY SPEEDRUNNING!

[h1]More Information [/h1]
https://www.speedrun.com/thalamus
[url=https://livesplit.org/]Live Split[/url] is needed and the configuration file can be found in the 'speedrunning' channel in our [url=https://discord.gg/YathE3G2uK]discord server[/url]

notes.title: Our Plans For Thalamus
notes.content:
Hello everyone. It's us again, we're making this post so we can tell you guys how we plan to move forward with thalamus, but first we want to thank everyone who has supported us after the release. Whether you made a video, bought the game or just recommended it to a friend, from the bottom of our hearts we thank every single one of you. We weren't expecting the game to be as popular as it has become, and we hear your criticism about chapter 1. We are planning on fixing some issues that you all have pointed out, (such as the loud intro) as well as adding a few extra things so that players know why they are doing the things they do in chapter 1. 


Once we do this we will put all our effort into chapter 2 and use it to clear up any questions that chapter 1 didn't answer (such as imperium and what it is). We also plan on there being more variation in what you will be doing, such as combat.


We don't have a release date for these updates yet but if you have any problems with thalamus then please let us know, whether it be on our discord or in the steam forums, we will read it and try to fix it.

notes.title: Thalamus Bug Update
notes.content: We had a few bugs on launch but most of the issues should be solved by tomorrow. Once again please let us know if you find any fame breaking bugs.

notes.title: Update Thalamus soundtrack (1.2)
notes.content: Hello everyone, this is the Thalamus development team back to tell you all that we have added a new song to the Thalamus soundtrack. As we come closer to the release of the first part of Thalamus we would like to show (or rather let you listen) to a new song by our composer. The song is called “Dreadful Regret” and we hope you like it. Thalamus is coming along nicely, and it looks like we will meet the planned release window (hopefully). Again, we are very active on our discord server if you want to talk to us ( https://discord.gg/YathE3G2uK ). That is all from us, we at the Thalamus development team wish you all a good day :)

notes.title: Thalamus Release Plan
notes.content:
Hi everyone, the Thalamus development team is here to update you guys on how we plan to update the game when it is released. Originally, we planned to release the game in a complete state in about a month, however, we have realized that we will not be able to meet the deadline that we have set, instead of releasing an unpolished game that no one on the development team would be happy with or delaying the game for an unforeseen amount of time, we have come to a compromise.
 
We plan on releasing part of the game in April and releasing the rest of the game as gradual updates, we are doing this because we do not want you guys waiting an extra year for the game to release and not like the finished product. We are also doing this so we can fund the game and hopefully make a better game than we originally planned.

We completely understand if you are upset at this news, this is not what we want either, but we hope we can use this opportunity to make a better game with better funding. However, we also plan to make a road map so you can all know when updates for the game will be released. We want to remain 100% transparent with all of you and make Thalamus the best possible game, that we can make.
With all this being said, we here at trulyDigital thank you for reading this update and hope you have an amazing time with Thalamus. If you have any questions, we are very active on the Thalamus discord which you can join here:  https://discord.gg/pKFNMMHgwS
